shelves.title: Boarding School
shelves.tagline: Nigeria, a dormitory, and the lessons nobody put on the syllabus.
shelves.description: Yeyeside spent her early school years in a Nigerian boarding school. These articles cover favouritism, bullying, survival and the three things she only understood once she left.

shelves.title: Getting Into College
shelves.tagline: Applications, deadlines, and the move from senior year to freshman year.
shelves.description: The part she is here to help with most. How to choose where to apply, what to know the day you graduate high school, and how to ask a professor for a recommendation that actually lands.

shelves.title: Surviving College
shelves.tagline: Deadlines, homesickness, internships, and doing it all as an only child.
shelves.description: Once you are in, the work changes. Time management, the apps worth installing, landing an internship as an undergraduate, and why being an only child changes the college experience.

shelves.title: Money
shelves.tagline: Saving, investing and paying for all of it.
shelves.description: Saving on a student budget and the first steps into investing. This is the thinnest shelf today and the one with the most room to grow: financial aid, scholarships, and paying for college are next.

shelves.title: Culture and Voice
shelves.tagline: Three passports, one voice. Family, language, style and speaking up.
shelves.description: Nigerian, Namibian and South African. These are the personal essays: a Namibian mother, learning Yoruba, a first vote, and why she started writing in the first place.
